whims.comment: Whims by what it knows of the game (personality/Lore: "knows"): a veteran's tips, only about what it knows.

lines: pro tip: never sleep in the nether
bring fire res to the nether trust me
wear gold in the nether or the piglins jump you
nether portals go 8 blocks for 1 btw
dont dig straight down in the nether. lava everywhere
build your portal on blocks you placed, ghasts break the rest

whims.thought: giving a tip about the Nether

lines: 15 bookshelves for max level enchants
mending is the best enchant fr
put unbreaking on everything
dont waste levels on the 1 level enchant
leave a block of air between the table and the shelves
lapis goes in the table, keep some on you
blaze powder fuels the brewing stand
nether wart first, then the rest
redstone makes potions last longer
glowstone makes them stronger but shorter
gunpowder for splash potions
fermented spider eye flips a potion, kinda
dont drink an ominous bottle unless you want a raid
kill the evokers first, vexes are the worst
evokers drop totems btw
a raid can get rough, get the villagers inside
ravagers hit like a truck, shield up
bring loads of blocks to the end, the void is no joke
wear a pumpkin and endermen leave you alone
eyes of ender break sometimes, bring extra
dont look at endermen. just dont
beds blow up in the end. use that on the dragon

whims.thought: giving a tip about the End

lines: comparators can tell how full a chest is
observers are so op
repeaters carry a signal further
a redstone torch turns off when its block gets power
hoppers into chests = free sorting, sort of
cure a zombie villager for cheap trades
librarians are the best villagers
trade once to lock a villager's job
a villager won't take a job without a workstation
emeralds are the money, farm them
a trial key opens a vault, one each
breezes knock your arrows away, go melee
ominous trials have the better loot
trial spawners come back after a while
watch out for the breeze's wind charges near ledges
